title: Blue dwarfs drag a man behind a curtain at the 'horror store'
place_text: between 7th Avenue and Broadway, near West 55th Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: there's a guy trying to in a brown suit trying to get out and he's being pulled back by these blue dwarfs.

plain: In the 1970s, in a shop in Manhattan near West 55th Street, between 7th Avenue and Broadway, a man in a brown suit was dragged back behind a curtain by small blue beings, according to the writer Whitley Strieber, who is known for describing his own encounters with visitors. Strieber says he saw it himself at what he calls the "horror store," with the man trying to get out while the blue dwarfs pulled him back, and he names his wife Anne Strieber in the telling.
